entry.title: Hopfield Networks – From Spin Glass to Attention
entry.summary: Why every language model is, at its core, a Hopfield network from 1982. A mathematical chain from Ising and Hebb through the pseudoinverse to the Modern Hopfield identity with Transformer attention – 2024 Nobel Prize, seven chapters, five interactive MNIST demos.

entry.title: Waves, Arrows and the Double-Slit Wonder
entry.summary: How quantum physics really works – explained with little arrows that spin. Seven chapters, eight interactive visualizations.

entry.summary: From the Bloch sphere to Shor's algorithm: an honest look at quantum computers with interactive circuits and real Qiskit code.

entry.title: Fourier, Ocean Waves and 65,536 Frequencies — How an 1822 Idea Shapes Water, Images and Music Today
entry.summary: How the Fourier Transform from 1822 generates ocean waves on the GPU, compresses JPEG images, and encodes music. With interactive visualizations, KaTeX formulas, and the history from FFT to Tessendorf.

entry.title: Eigenvalues & AI – Why artificial intelligence is an eigenvalue problem
entry.summary: From the simplest regression to the most powerful neural network – a single mathematical chain, explained through eigenvalues.

entry.title: Are Emergent Abilities in LLMs Real? An Interactive Deep Dive
entry.summary: Are emergent abilities in LLMs real or measurement artifacts? Interactive walkthrough of Wei vs. Schaeffer with live scaling curves and phase transition visualizations.

entry.title: God as an Emergent Phenomenon
entry.summary: A formal theory of coherence: five axioms, six proven theorems — including NP-hardness of coherence maximization and plural stable end states. Foundation for a relational concept of God in the Whitehead-Spinoza tradition.

entry.title: Why Major Sounds Happy – Music, Mathematics & Perception
entry.summary: Why does a major chord sound happy and a minor chord sad? From frequency ratios through Pythagoras to the cochlea – the mathematics of music, explained interactively.

entry.title: The Limits of Provability – Self-Reference, Gödel & Turing
entry.summary: From Russell's paradox through Gödel's incompleteness theorems to Turing's halting problem – why mathematics cannot prove everything, explained interactively.

entry.title: The Glass Bead Game – A Meta-Journey Through Science, Mindfulness & Self-Reference
entry.summary: A meta blog post connecting quantum physics, eigenvalues, emergence, music, mindfulness and Gödel into one coherent Glass Bead Game. Interactive visualizations, no prerequisites required.

entry.title: Dwelling in the Moment — Mindfulness as an End in Itself
entry.summary: A phenomenological, neuroscientific, and aesthetic observation of attention. With Hardy, Husserl, James, and the neuroscience of pausing. Mindfulness needs no justification beyond its own elegance.

entry.title: Why e Is Special – The Number Behind Growth, Primes, and Chance
